cases.explain: «отцовский урок» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

cases.explain: «жестокий урок» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.

cases.explain: «счастливом сердце» — after the preposition «при», for location or topic.
cases.translation: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

cases.explain: «злыми мыслями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

cases.explain: «Радостный взгляд» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
